scope: Selected fully-contained 4KiB A copies only; fixed every-sixteenth sampling. Not all A copies, not all request types, not an M control evaluation.
fixed_feature_estimator: With globally fixed weights, wB*4096+wR*4+wM*2 is constant for these observations. It cannot reproduce both sets of observed per-run main-occupancy medians exactly.
limits: Full typed-event baseline was not measured or refuted.
Fixed-phase sampling can select unrepresentative copies.
Adding gap changes timing and other contention.
Residual cost variation alone does not establish predictive or control value.
